provenance.robot: UR5e + reviewed BDS mock-pruner, six actuated UR joints
provenance.controller: known-geometry scripted Cartesian differential IK with physical implicit joint drives and measured ToF stop gate; no learned CV input
provenance.robot_state: measured PhysX articulation state, not teleported joint replay
provenance.wrist_rgb: RTX rgb annotator; exterior tool-mounted camera with fixed simulation-defined toe-in; not hardware calibration
provenance.close_rgb: RTX rgb annotator; static external close-up camera
provenance.depth: RTX distance_to_image_plane; simulator ground truth, not learned depth
provenance.tof: two live MultiMeshRayCasterCamera 8x8 15Hz at reviewed sensor offsets; noise disabled
provenance.environment: procedural finite-cylinder pruning fixture and tree backdrop
provenance.cutting: inspection at standoff only; no wood severing or trained policy
provenance.contact: PhysX measured forces; coverage recorded explicitly

lab3_compat: isaaclab.utils.math: unwrap ProxyArray on 32 scripted fns

capture_quality.evidence_scope: Carb setting readback only; not measured sample count or visual quality

camera.wrist_mount: simulation-defined exterior mount; fixed optical toe-in initialized using the known fixture target
camera.wrist_optical_convention: +Z forward, +X right, +Y down (ROS); fixed rotation relative to tool recorded above

capture_quality_after_warmup.evidence_scope: Carb setting readback only; not measured sample count or visual quality

capture_quality_at_end.evidence_scope: Carb setting readback only; not measured sample count or visual quality

display_processing.scope: Display only; source images, CV inputs, depth and ToF measurements are unchanged

gif_preview.timeline: Uniform samples across the full capture, with held frames; not real-time frame density

channels.depth: Recorded renderer distance_to_image_plane ground truth; not learned depth
channels.tof: Recorded dual 8 x 8 ray-cast range observations; missing pixels are not filled
channels.vision: Offline OpenCV Farneback diagnostic from consecutive recorded wrist RGB; not a controller input
channels.offline_optical_flow: Offline OpenCV Farneback diagnostic from consecutive recorded wrist RGB; not a controller input
channels.brown_candidate: Offline RGB color threshold and largest connected component when OpenCV is available; only shown on frames without live tracker evidence

limitations: The compositor does not determine task success; inspect source_report and numerical evidence.
Optical flow is pixels per captured frame, not 3-D velocity or a learned depth estimate.
Range color limits are fixed at 0.03 to 3.40 m; black pixels may also be beyond display range.
Scripted motion and cut phase labels do not establish wood severing or trained policy performance.
Brown-pixel segmentation can select the wrong object; it does not identify the target.
